title: vernonia crotonoides
intro: Vernonia crotonoides, commonly known as Ironweed, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia crotonoides include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, making it a potential remedy for conditions like arthritis and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
